plan.failureSummary: Cached page.ai step failed to locate the 'Last Name' input field because the dynamic survey rendered a different form variant ('Your Name' / 'Contact Email').
observedIndicators: The failing step executed inside generated cache file '.cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js' (failureInCacheReplay is true).
Cached instruction looked for '[data-testid=\'input-lastname\']' and 'Last Name *', but the live failure screenshot displays 'Your Name *' and 'Contact Email *'.
No application errors or 5xx network responses were recorded in browser logs.
The overall objective is semantically flexible ('Fill out all of the survey questions with fake data...') and intended to handle shifting form layouts.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and re-run automation
remediationSteps.details: Clear the cached instructions in .cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js and re-run the test autonomously so page.ai generates fresh actions against the active DOM variant.

plan.notes: The test targets an unstable/dynamic survey where fields and element IDs vary across loads. The failure happened directly within the cached replay (.cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js). Clearing the cache and running autonomously will allow page.ai to adapt to the current form layout.
